Metadata.title: Pisa
Metadata.description: A reality check for viral videos: is what you see physically possible?

Home.tagline: AI can fake pixels. It can't fake physics.
Home.lede: Send a video of something falling, thrown or bouncing. Pisa measures its motion and tells you whether real gravity could have produced it.

Check.title: Check a video
Check.scope: Pisa checks falls, throws and bounces. It does not check face swaps, lip-sync or cloned voices.
Check.fileHint: MP4 or MOV, up to 60 seconds and 50 MB.

explanations.slows_down_while_falling: The object slows down while it is still falling. Gravity and air can't do that.
explanations.acceleration_grows: The object speeds up faster and faster as it falls. Gravity pulls steadily, so real falls don't do that.
explanations.accelerates_upward: The object speeds up toward the sky, as if gravity pulled upward.
explanations.impossible: The way this object moves breaks a law of physics that every real fall follows.
explanations.consistent: The object speeds up at a steady rate as it falls, the way real gravity makes things fall.
explanations.weak_violation: Something in the motion looks off, but not clearly enough to call it impossible.
explanations.no_measurable_acceleration: The object moves at a steady speed, so there is no fall to measure.
explanations.depth_change: The object moves toward or away from the camera, which bends its path on screen too much to measure.
explanations.too_few_samples: The object is visible in too few frames to measure its motion.
explanations.no_measurable_events: Pisa couldn't find a fall, throw or bounce it could measure in this video.

Result.consistentNote: This doesn't prove the video is real. It means the motion we measured breaks no law we check.

cards.accelerationDetail: Real falls speed up at a steady rate.
cards.fitDetail: Average distance between the measured path and the closest steady-gravity path.
cards.phasesDetail: Stretches of free flight between release, bounces and landing.

Result.limits: Pisa checks how objects fall, fly and bounce. It doesn't check faces, lip-sync or voices.

Errors.unsupported_format: This file isn't a video Pisa can read. Try an MP4 or MOV.
Errors.video_too_long: This video is longer than 60 seconds. Trim it to the moment that matters and try again.
Errors.file_too_large: This file is larger than 50 MB.
Errors.unknown_duration: Pisa couldn't tell how long this video is. Try exporting it again as MP4.
Errors.resolution_too_high: This video's resolution is too high. Try a version at 4K or less.
Errors.transcode_failed: Pisa couldn't prepare this video for measuring. Try exporting it again as MP4.
Errors.empty_window: There is nothing to measure in the part of the video that was selected.
Errors.paid_calls_disabled: Tracking is paused right now. Try again later.
